message.reasoning_content:
I need to describe the kernel. Analyze: DIF radix-2 complex FFT of length M=N/2 on packed real/imag pairs, then post-processing. Potential issues: line 83-84 stores to OUT + (row*(M+1)+M+0*k)*2 — that's OUT index for [row, M, 0]; fine (Nyquist bin). Store of Nyquist real part (ar - ai)? Standard rfft reconstruction: Nyquist = sum of alternating elements = X[M/2]... Actually for packed complex z[j]=x[2j]+i*x[2j+1], Z[k] = FFT_M(z)[k]. X[k] = ... Nyquist X[N/2] = X[M] = sum (-1)^j x[j]... Standard: X[k] = (Zr[k]+Zr[M-k] + cos·(Zi[k]-Zi[M-k]) ... ). Nyquist X[M] = Zr[?]... = sum x[j](-1)^j = Re(Z[M/2]?)... Not going to verify deeply; record description update with risk map.

Also risk: float16 input cast to float64 — good. Twiddle table for N=64: 256//width etc, table covers 0..64 (65 entries) — _COSINE has 65 entries. phase range: k*(256//N) max (M-1)*(256/N)... For N=256, M=128, k up to 127, phase = k*1 up to 127; folded = min(phase,128-phase) ≤ 64 fine; sine index abs(64-phase) ≤ 64 fine.

Risks: DIF loop for stage 0: width=M, half=M/2... fine. Line 83: mask k==0 stores Nyquist as ar-ai where ar,ai gathered at address=0 and partner=0 — that's Z[0], so Zr[0]-Zi[0]? Nyquist X[M] = Zr[M/2]-Zi[M/2]... hmm actually X[M] = sum_j x[j](-1)^j. Z[M/2] = sum_j z[j] e^{-2πi j (M/2)/M} = sum_j z[j](-1)^j. Re - Im gives sum (-1)^j (x[2j] - x[2j+1])? Not the Nyquist. Actual X[M] = sum_n x[n] e^{-iπ n} = sum_n (-1)^n x[n]. That equals sum_j [(-1)^{2j}x[2j] + (-1)^{2j+1}x[2j+1]] = sum_j (x[2j]-x[2j+1]) = Re(Z[M/2]) - Im(Z[M/2])? Z[M/2]=sum_j (x[2j]+i x[2j+1])(-1)^j; Re=Σ(-1)^j x[2j], Im=Σ(-1)^j x[2j+1]. Re - Im = Σ(-1)^j(x[2j]-x[2j+1]). But X[M]=Σ(x[2j]-x[2j+1]) — no (-1)^j factor. Hmm, X[M] = Σ_n (-1)^n x[n]; pairs n=2j,2j+1: (-1)^{2j}=1, (-1)^{2j+1}=-1. So X[M]=Σ_j(x[2j]-x[2j+1]). Meanwhile ar-ai at k=0: address=0, partner=0, so ar=Z[0].real, ai=Z[0].imag; ar-ai = Σ x[2j] - Σ x[2j+1] = X[M]. Yes correct. But note: gather uses address (bit-reversed) of k=0 → 0, correct Z[0] not Z[M/2]. Good.

But line 83-84 also overwrite? k==0 masked store to index (row*(M+1)+M) — separate from k loop stores at k<M. OK.

Risk areas to flag: twiddle sign conventions, DIF with gather semantics, bit-reversal correctness, numerical accuracy vs 1e-4 tolerance for large FP16 values (values up to 65504; sum of 256 terms could be ~1.6e7; absolute error 1e-4 relative 1e-6 of exact ~ tens; FP64 internal should be fine but table has only ~17 digits; twiddle table entries are cos of multiples of 2π/256, double precision—fine).

Also tl.gather availability in Triton 3.4, correctness of k & ~half indexing. Risk: enable_fp_fusion=False. Note _twiddle: cosine = where(phase<=64, cosine, -cosine) — for phase in 64..128, folded=128-phase gives cos of angle; sign flip correct for cos(π-θ)... fine.

Also risk: output for N=64: 256//N=4, phase=k*4 up to 124 fine.

Record update.
